title: Body copy typeface
slide_intent: Select a text face that can carry longer reading while a display face draws attention to the heading. A change in weight can signal role without changing families again.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can give publications and digital communications a consistent, legible reading voice through Raleway Regular and Bold.
demonstration: A large Raleway sentence combines bold and regular weight, with its first word underlined in pink. Regular and Bold character sets sit beneath the specimen.
practical_value: Set body copy in Raleway Regular and use Raleway Bold for emphasis. Use Arial Regular and Bold where system fonts are required.

content_islands.name: Face and fallback
content_islands.spec: Describe the body face in the left column and show its two Arial alternatives beneath.

content_islands.name: Weight specimen
content_islands.spec: Set a large mixed-weight sentence in the right field and underline the face name with a loose pink stroke.

content_islands.name: Character sets
content_islands.spec: Align smaller Regular and Bold specimens beneath the sentence to show the available weights in running text.
